title: Video of Townsend Brown celebrating at UNC Chapel Hill
place_text: University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

tellings.quote: There are even videos of Townsen Brown at the University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, celebrating because his experiments presumably worked.

plain: There are said to be videos of an American inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, celebrating because his experiments had apparently worked. The story places this in the 1950s. Michels tells it himself without naming the source of the footage, and he takes the celebration as a hint that Brown's unusual experiments, which his episode connects to strange flying objects, got results.
